messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: notifier-service failing to send pages via PagerFlow (500s). 60 failed attempts in last 5m, auto-retries suppressed by suppressor.

sre-oncall (raj): seeing it. can anyone confirm customer impact? are pages actually not reaching oncall?

lisa (support): getting a few customer reports that their critical alerts didn't page overnight. ticket #13124 references missed page.

kevin (pagerduty-integration): PagerFlow shows incoming webhooks accepted but response 500 from our notify-proxy. payload id starts with pf-9a3.

emma (platform): probable regression from yesterday's suppressor change. suppressor service started skipping retries when downstream 5xx returned.

raj: can we manually trigger failover to the legacy-notifier while we investigate?

emma (platform): yes. plan: 1) flip route to legacy-notifier (manual) 2) bounce notify-proxy 3) add temporary retry override.

kevin (pagerduty-integration): on it. toggling route now -> using /routes/fallback endpoint.

deploy-bot: deploy started: route-manager@prod v3.7.1 -> toggling pagerflow->legacy-notifier.

kevin (pagerduty-integration): route flipped. sending test page to raj now.

raj: received test page :phone: — manual failover worked.

lisa (support): alerted affected customers that pages should be restored, monitoring.

raj: next, we need logs and a minimal repro. emma, can you tail notify-proxy logs and grep for pf-9a3 ids?

emma (platform): tailing logs. found stacktrace: "NullPointer in suppressor: decisionEngine.evaluate()" when attempt.headers['X-Retry'] missing.

kevin (pagerduty-integration): reproducer: curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"id":"pf-9a3","alert":"test"}' https://notify.example.com/pf -> 500 and suppressor returns "no-retry" header.

emma (platform): quick patch: default X-Retry to "true" if missing in request and avoid NPE. creating hotfix.

deploy-bot: build published: notify-proxy@hotfix-358 -> image sha: sha256:abc123.

raj: let's rollout hotfix to one instance first (canary) and confirm pages flow through without suppressor blocking retries.

emma (platform): canary deployed to zone-a, health checks green. sending synthetic alerts now.

kevin (pagerduty-integration): synthetic pages delivered. metrics show failed pages dropping to 0 in canary.

raj: promote to rest of fleet.

deploy-bot: rollout complete: notify-proxy@hotfix-358 -> All instances updated.

emma (platform): monitoring for 15m. suppressor error rate back to baseline.

lisa (support): notified customers that pages restored and we’re investigating root cause; CS asked for ETA on RCA.

raj: immediate mitigation done. next actions: 1) postmortem draft 2) revert suppressor change or harden it 3) add integration test for missing X-Retry header 4) add an alert when suppressor returns >10% no-retry in 5m.

kevin (pagerduty-integration): will add integration test in pagerflow test harness.

emma (platform): creating PR for suppressor fix and tests, will include log improvements to capture request ids.

raj: thanks everyone. once PR merged, we can close customer tickets. leaving thread open until postmortem posted. :thumbsup:

lisa (support): thanks — escalating to account teams for affected customers.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-17-3580001122 created. severity: P2. responders: raj, emma, kevin, lisa.

emma (platform): postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/pm/3580001122 (will add timeline + remediation).

raj: last check: all clear, marking incident stable. will schedule follow-up to review deploy process and suppressor change gating.

lisa (support): resolved for customers, closing tickets after follow-up email.

incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-17-3580001122 status: resolved.
